research_source: Ratings: EdgeDesk’s NFL rating state — trained seeds through 2025 plus 31 absorbed 2026 games, opponent-adjusted from the public nflverse team-week feed. Projection: the same edgedesk_football_v1.0.0 call the game card makes. Nothing on this page was computed in your browser twice.
market_source: The sportsbook number on this page is a quote EdgeDesk captured at FanDuel and Pinnacle on 2026-09-22, replayed from a committed snapshot rather than read live. It is the book’s number, not EdgeDesk’s, and EdgeDesk’s own number was produced before it was read. Source: EdgeDesk odds capture (public.signals), read by the newsletter pipeline.

lede: Seattle Seahawks carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#9 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it Washington Commanders +5.7 with a fair total of 45.8 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Seattle Seahawks pass offence vs Washington Commanders pass defence, which sits +0.247 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
